name: cavemio-live-line-chart
title: Live line chart
description: One metric as it happens: each point slides in at an even pace, the scale eases, and a Live pill pauses the view.

cavemio.usage:
import { LiveLineChart } from "@/components/live-line-chart";

<LiveLineChart
  label="Requests"
  unit="req/s"
  data={points} // [{ t: Date.now(), value: 1096 }, …] — keep appending
  threshold={{ value: 1200, label: "Rate limit" }}
/>
cavemio.accessibility:
- Grey in a new shadcn project? Its default theme sets --chart-1 to --chart-5 to greys. Set five colours, light and dark, as in Theming › Chart colours (/ui/theming#charts).
- The plot is decoration; a visually hidden line gives the latest value and its change, and it isn’t a live region, so a reading a second never floods a screen reader.
- The Live pill is a toggle button (aria-pressed) with its own label for pausing and resuming.
- The line is drawn in value space inside one scaled group, so a new range is a single transform transition; the slide is a second transform around it. No animation frame loop runs.
- Rising change is emerald and falling red, each with an arrow, so colour is never the only signal.
- It sizes to its own width; the figure and type step up from about 450px.
- Installs Number roll and Text morph, and adds the ui-ping keyframes. With reduced motion the line steps, nothing pings and the scale changes in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: data
props.description: – · Points oldest first as { t (ms), value }; keep appending. Older than the window is left out.

props.name: window
props.description: 60000 · How much time the chart shows, in ms.

props.name: format
props.description: { maximumFractionDigits: 0 } · How the figure is written. The axis uses compact numbers.

props.name: threshold
props.description: – · A limit drawn as a dashed line, always kept in view.

props.name: color
props.description: var(--chart-1) · The line and its fill.

props.name: onPausedChange
props.description: – · Called when the Live pill pauses or resumes.

props.name: staleAfter
props.description: 3 × the last gap · Ms without a new point before the pill says Waiting.

useCases.title: API and infrastructure dashboards
useCases.description: Requests, errors or latency per second, against a rate limit or an SLO.

useCases.title: Launch and live event pages
useCases.description: Sign-ups, checkouts or viewers as they arrive.

useCases.title: Trading and pricing screens

useCases.title: IoT and monitoring panels

features.title: Smooth scrolling
features.description: Each point slides in over the gap it took to arrive, so the line never jumps.

features.title: A scale that eases
features.description: Round gridlines that hold every value in view; when they change the line rescales and the figures roll.

features.title: The header is the readout
features.description: Point at the line and the figure rolls to that moment, with how long ago it was.

features.title: Pause and catch up
features.description: The Live pill holds the view still while data keeps coming; press it again to catch up.

features.title: A stalled feed shows
features.description: When points stop arriving the pill says Waiting and its pulse stops.

features.title: Limits in view
features.description: A threshold is drawn as a dashed amber line with its label, and always kept inside the scale.

states.title: stream
states.description: A new point starts one step to the right and the line slides into place, linear, over the gap since the previous point (capped at 4s); the end dot follows the line and pings while live.

states.title: scale
states.description: The range is three round gridlines with 15% room; a new range eases the line (600ms) under fixed gridlines while the axis figures roll.

states.title: point
states.description: Pointing at the plot snaps to the nearest point: a thin line and a dot mark it, the figure rolls to its value and “now” morphs to “12s ago”.

states.title: pause
states.description: The Live pill (aria-pressed) holds the points on show; new data is kept and shown again on resume.

states.title: waiting
states.description: With no new point for three times the last gap (or staleAfter), the pill morphs to Waiting, its dot turns amber and stops pulsing.
